title: Special Front Wall Regulations
previewText: The street wall location provisions of paragraph (a) of Section 35-631 (Street wall location) shall apply. For the purposes of applying street wall location provisions, all streets shall be considered wide streets. For all buildings within Area B, the exterior materials of the front wall shall be predominantly of masonry.
